content.short: Guarda Wallet enables secure, multi-currency crypto management for both beginners and experts.
content.description: Guarda Wallet is a non-custodial, multi-currency platform for securely storing, managing, and exchanging cryptocurrencies. Founded in 2017 by Paul Sokolov, it has become a trusted name in the crypto space. Designed for both newcomers and seasoned users, the wallet offers streamlined asset management, built-in exchanges, and robust security features. It enables users to send, receive, and exchange a variety of cryptocurrencies while keeping their digital assets under their own control.
content.meta: Guarda Wallet is a non-custodial, multi-currency wallet for secure crypto storage. Discover Guarda Wallet and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
